scope: Cap-specific linked-standard nuisance inputs for DESI DR1 LRGxELG regional robustness
status: development validation checkpoint; frozen before regional wake interpretation

common.transition: ELG Doppler-bias benchmark applies below z=1 and is set to 0 above z=1

SGC.smoothing_note: The SGC ELG middle-bin f_evo estimate has a large smoothing half-range (~2.1448) and is treated as an uncertain benchmark nuisance input.

interpretation: NGC and SGC did not share one common linked-standard template. The regional robustness test used cap-specific selection-function/evolution-bias and external magnification/Doppler benchmark inputs.
guardrail: These nuisance inputs are not retuned after inspection of the regional wake amplitudes.
